summary: Verified the getSnapshot() hotfix (fresh nested obs/chips/feathers/heckler/jab/pint references every call) in Drunk Pigeons on web preview. All 4 maps launch and play; obstacles are visible and moving; SPLAT/Play-Again cycles work; dev HUD confirms pool:9, mountsSinceStart building:0 structureShape:0 obstacleView:0, and recycles:21 after ~10 restart cycles. Node regression test 'yarn test:engine' passes. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: the specific native-only Reanimated shareable-caching bug being fixed CANNOT be reproduced in this web-preview/Playwright environment - Reanimated's web fallback does not exhibit the object-identity caching behavior. True confirmation of the fix requires the user's physical Android APK. This report only certifies functional/visual regression on web preview - obstacles visible+moving in all scenarios and none of the earlier fixes (SPAWN_LOOKAHEAD, pool sizes, mount-count, timer cleanup) have regressed.
action_items: USER MUST VERIFY on physical Android APK (versionCode 4) that obstacles are visible and moving from the very first obstacle of every run - this is the ONLY environment where the original native-shareable-caching bug manifests.
critical_code_review_comments: getSnapshot() (engine.js ~L644-692) now correctly builds fresh arrays/objects via .map()/object-literals every call for obs/chips/feathers/heckler/jab/pint - matches Node regression test expectations.
Dev HUD reports pool:9 and mountsSinceStart building:0 structureShape:0 obstacleView:0 after extensive play, confirming OBSTACLE_POOL=9 and the ObstacleView dual-mount fix are intact.
recycles counter increased to 21 over ~10 restart cycles, confirming obstacle recycling flow is healthy.
Minor: engine.js is now ~770 lines; approaching maintainability threshold - consider splitting spawn/obstacle/collision logic into submodules in a future pass (informational, not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration verified engine.js getSnapshot() hotfix. Web preview tests all pass but the underlying bug is native-Android-only (Reanimated shareable clone caching by JS object identity). Node regression test at frontend/src/game/__tests__/getSnapshot.regression.mjs (run via 'yarn test:engine') is the strongest available proof in this environment - it directly asserts every snapshot.obs/chips/feathers/heckler/jab/pint and every element inside obs/chips/feathers is a fresh reference every call, and passes. Dev HUD (data-testid=dev-perf-stats) is a great signal - watch for pool:9 and mountsSinceStart *:0 to prove pool sizing + dual-mount fix are intact.
rca of the issue: Original bug (pass #2/#3): getSnapshot() reused persistent outObs/outChips/etc. buffers, mutating same nested objects each frame. Reanimated on native Android caches nested worklet values as shareable clones keyed by JS object identity - since references never changed, UI thread kept reading the first-ever-transferred stale positions, freezing obstacles off-screen. Fix (this hotfix): reverted to fresh .map()/object-literal allocation every getSnapshot() call. Not reproducible on web because Reanimated web fallback does not use shareable-clone identity caching. Mitigation: Node regression test now guards against re-introduction; recommend adding a comment in getSnapshot() warning future optimizers not to reuse nested object references.
